events.title: These 3 Companies Crushed Key Metrics This Earnings Season
events.body: Several companies, inlcuding Alphabet, Roku, and Interactive Brokers, have crushed it concerning key metrics, with each also seeing share momentum in the days that have followed post-earnings.

events.title: COIN to Report Q1 Earnings:  Buy the Stock Now or Wait for Results?
events.body: Coinbase will report Q1 results on May 7. Revenue and EPS estimates fall amid weaker crypto volumes. Will subscriptions and USDC soften the blow?
